<!--
A good report here is a measurement, not a description. The most useful
thing you can give us is the command you ran and the output you got —
especially when it disagrees with what you expected.

If you are reporting something you observed on a live edge rather than
reading the source, say so. We treat those differently: the source is a
claim about behaviour, the host is the behaviour.
-->

## What happened

<!-- Observed behaviour. Paste real output rather than paraphrasing it. -->

## What you expected instead

<!-- And where that expectation comes from: a doc line, a comment, a log
message that promised otherwise. -->

## How to reproduce

<!-- Exact commands. If it only reproduces on a live host, describe the host
state that matters. -->

## Environment

- Release / `IMAGE_VERSION`:
- OS and arch:
- Channels in use (ch1 Reality / ch2 AmneziaWG / ch3 Hysteria2 / coturn):

## How confident are you in the cause

<!-- Optional, and genuinely optional. If you have a hypothesis, say what
would refute it — that is far more useful to us than a confident guess.
"I do not know why" is a complete and welcome answer. -->
